page.overview:
What is Not a Second Time?

Not a Second Time is a song by The Beatles. It is the sixth song on side two of The Beatles' Second UK LP, "With The Beatles". It is credited to Lennon/McCartney.

This song was inspired by Smokey Robinson and the Miracles. The song was another example of John letting his feelings, in this case of being wounded, to wash all over his work.
